pageCache.pageTitle: The Oaks | Aldermaston CE Primary School
pageCache.text:
Welcome to The Oaks
Community
Wraparound Care
Welcome to The Oaks
We offer breakfast and after school clubs at Aldermaston CE Primary School, Mortimer St. John’s Infant School, Mortimer St. Mary’s Junior School, Silchester Primary School and The Priory Primary School. The Oaks Club was started over 20 years ago and has evolved from one club run by volunteer parents to a community interest company running 11 clubs over four sites with over 300 children being looked after by a friendly, professional team of up to 40 staff.
Our Clubs provide a fun, safe place for children to play before and after their school day. We work closely with the schools, parents and children to provide continuity of care and to create an environment that works for each child.
Working with Parents
All parents want to know that their child is safe and happy while in our care. Our staff are very experienced at working with children of all ages. We aim to make their time at the club as relaxing and fun as possible and will spend time getting to know them and what they enjoy doing.
Familiar Location: Aldermaston Oaks breakfast and after school clubs are held in the school hall at Aldermaston CE Primary School. This helps your child relax in familiar surroundings after a full school day. We facilitate and oversee outside play in all but the most extreme of weather conditions. Our staff have a positive attitude to the outdoor environment and physical activity.
Child-led play: Your child decides whether they want to run around outside, draw with friends or chill out quietly with a book. Our staff support children to relax and have fun, whatever their needs or interests.
Healthy food: Breakfasts and snacks after school are healthy and varied. We can accommodate any dietary requirements or preferences.
Expert staff: Our team are carefully selected to bring a wide range of skills and experience to each club. Across the clubs, our team have many years of combined professional childcare experience and all have regular updates to their training and development. All staff are subject to enhanced DBS checks prior to employment.
Breakfast Club – Early Aldermaston Oaks
Children can be dropped off at the school hall from 7.30am. A wide range of breakfast choices including fresh fruit, cereal, yogurt and water is provided to prepare the children for the day ahead. After having time to play children then make their way to their classrooms ready to start the school day.
Breakfast sessions – £7.40
After School Club – Aldermaston Oaks
Aldermaston Oaks after school club runs from the end of the school day until 18:00. We are based in the school hall and children can come straight to the club or via one of the school-led clubs first.
A wide range of healthy snacks are on offer so that the children can eat and drink as they choose.
After School sessions – £14.50 – with a full time and sibling discount rate of £14.00.
Often the biggest complaint from our parents is that their child won’t come home because they are having too much fun!
If you are interested in registering your child with the Oaks please complete the Registration Pack which can be accessed via the link or contact our Office Team on office@theoakschildcare.co.uk. Core office hours are from 10am to 2pm.
More information about The Oaks is available from our website.

pageCache.pageTitle: School dinners  | Aldermaston CE Primary School
pageCache.text:
School Dinners
School meals at Aldermaston are provided by Educatering Solutions. A choice of nutritionally balanced hot and cold meals and sandwiches are available daily. These also include a vegetarian and jacket potato/pasta option. All children in KS1 (Foundation Stage, Years 1 & 2) are entitled to a free school lunch.
Lunches need to be ordered from home for the week ahead by Tuesday lunchtime, this can be actioned for the whole term in advance.
Some children in KS2 are also entitled to free school meals. If you feel your child may be eligible please contact the school office for further information and guidance, or contact freeschoolmeals@westberks.gov.uk or 01635 503622.
Scopay - our new dinner ordering and payment system has now gone live and you should have all received an email explaining how to set your account up. If you need help, please contact the office at enquiries@aldermaston.w-berks.sch.uk for assistance.
Children are very welcome to bring in their own packed lunches. Please remember that we are a "No Nuts" school. We'd be really grateful for your help in ensuring that any food that may contain nuts is not brought onto the school site. Food provided from our school kitchen, including the packed lunches, is always nut free. Please check our 'No Nuts' Statement for further information.

pageCache.pageTitle: School hours | Aldermaston CE Primary School
pageCache.text:
School hours
The School Day
Our school day begins at 8:40am and ends at 3:20pm for all children.
Morning Arrival
Children should be dropped off and collected from the playground.
The school gates open at 8:40am and classroom doors 8:45am, allowing children to go straight into their classrooms and settle ready for the start of the day. The gates close promptly at 8:50am, when registers are taken.
If your child arrives after 8:50am, please bring them to the school office, where they can be signed in.
Kiss and Drop
If you are using our Kiss and Drop facility, your child should be confident walking independently from the drop-off point, through the school gates and into their classroom.
To help keep everyone safe and traffic flowing smoothly, please remember that the Kiss and Drop is for quick drop-offs only:
Thank you for helping us keep our school site safe and congestion-free.
No parking.
Drivers must remain in their vehicle.
Reporting an Absence
If your child is unable to attend school, please notify the school office by 9:00am on each day of their absence, either by telephone or email.
Thank you for helping us ensure the safety and wellbeing of all our pupils.
Breakfast and Afterschool Club
We offer wraparound childcare through our Breakfast Club and Afterschool Club.
For further information, including session times, costs and how to book, please click here .

Admissions
We currently have limited spaces available in certain year groups. If you are considering making an in-year application, please contact the school office, who will be happy to guide you through the process.
Open Morning for Prospective Parents
Is your child due to start school in September 2027? We would love to meet you our Open Morning on Tuesday 10th November 2026 at 9:15am. This will include a welcome talk, followed by a tour of the school. You are very welcome to bring your children with you.
Key Dates for September 2027 Admissions
The admissions process is administered by West Berkshire Council. Applications for children starting school in September 2027 are expected to open in September 2026, with a closing date of 15th January 2027. National Offer Day will take place on 16th April 2027.
Full details, including the complete admissions timetable and application process, will be published by West Berkshire Council when available.
Our school has a planned admission number of 15, which means that up to 15 children are allocated places each year as a matter of course. Individual year groups may have more or less than this number depending on the number of applicants.
Please contact the school office on 0118 9713362 or email enquiries@aldermaston.w-berks.sch.uk if you would like to find out more.
